about: The built-in strips' parameter notes, and the strips with a figure (web/explain/<kind>.explain.js). Made by tools/strip_examples.py.

ablate.mode: zero removes the component's output; mean puts its average over the reference corpus in its place.
ablate.head: One head as block.head (5.1), every head of a block (5.*), or several (5.1,5.3).
ablate.attn: The attention layer of a block, or several (3-7, 1,4, all).
ablate.mlp: The MLP of a block, or several (3-7, 1,4, all).
ablate.block: A whole block's contribution, its output minus its input, or several blocks.

scale.k: Multiplies what the component adds (or, on a layer, the whole stream): 1 changes nothing, 0 removes it, below 0 reverses it.
scale.head: One head as block.head (5.1), every head of a block (5.*), or several (5.1,5.3).
scale.attn: The attention layer of a block, or several (3-7, 1,4, all).
scale.mlp: The MLP of a block, or several (3-7, 1,4, all).
scale.block: A whole block's contribution, its output minus its input, or several blocks.
scale.layer: The residual stream itself: 0 is the embeddings, l the stream after block l − 1; all for every layer.

coarsen.bits: How finely the block's weight matrices are rounded: 8 is 127 levels a side, 4 is 7, 3 is 3, 2 is only −max, 0 and +max.
coarsen.block: The block whose weight matrices are rounded (or several); the rest of the model keeps full precision.

reorder.skip: Blocks left out of the run (6, or 3-5).
reorder.repeat: Blocks run twice in a row (5).

exit.layer: The layer the stream leaves at for the final norm and output layer: blocks from this one on are not run; the last layer changes nothing.

position.mode: shift reads position p + k, scramble a fixed random position for each, freeze position k for every token.
position.k: How many positions shift moves each token on (0 changes nothing), or the one position freeze reads; scramble ignores it.
position.seed: The seed of scramble's random positions (the run's seed if not given); shift and freeze ignore it.

steer.layer: The residual stream it adds to: 0 is the embeddings, l the output of block l − 1; all, a range (3-7) or a list (1,4) work too.
steer.dir: The direction added, by name, used as stored, so its length counts.
steer.scale: How many times the direction is added at every position; 0 changes nothing, below 0 pushes the other way.

project.layer: The residual stream it acts on: 0 is the embeddings, l the output of block l − 1; all, a range (3-7) or a list (1,4) work too.
project.dir: The direction whose part of the stream is taken away or turned round, by name; only its direction counts, not its length.
project.mode: remove takes the part along the direction away; reflect turns it round, so it points the other way.
project.to: zero measures the part from nothing; mean measures it from the stream's corpus mean, so remove sets it to the ordinary amount.
project.k: How many directions go at once: 1 is the direction alone, more adds the next principal directions of what it was made from.

noise.layer: The residual stream it adds noise to: 0 is the embeddings, l the output of block l − 1; all, a range (3-7) or a list (1,4) work too.
noise.sigma: How much noise: a share of each position's own size (its root mean square), so 1 adds about as much as the stream holds; 0 changes nothing.
noise.abs: On, sigma is an absolute amount, the same at every position, rather than a share of the stream's size.
noise.seed: The noise's own seed (the run's if left out): the same seed gives the same noise every pass.

transplant.layer: The residual stream that is replaced: 0 is the embeddings, l the output of block l − 1.
transplant.prompt: The other prompt, run on the unchanged model, whose stream is taken.
transplant.at: Which token of this prompt receives it: −1 is the last, −2 the one before; 0 and up count from the start.
transplant.from: Which token of the other prompt it is taken from: −1 is the last, −2 the one before; 0 and up count from the start.

embed.swap: Two single tokens, a,b: the model reads each with the other's input embedding (GPT-2 tokens usually start with a space).
embed.mix: With a swap, how far the first word's embedding moves toward the second's instead: 0 its own, 1 the second's; the second word is left as it is.
embed.token: One single token that gets a fixed noise vector added to its input embedding, wherever it occurs.
embed.sigma: With token=, the noise's size as a share of the token's embedding: 1 adds about as much as the embedding holds.

vocoder.layer: The one layer of the residual stream where the modulator's band levels are imposed: 0 is the embeddings, l the output of block l − 1.
vocoder.prompt: The modulator: the text whose band levels, measured on the unchanged model, are imposed on the text being written.
vocoder.bands: How many bands of principal directions, spaced logarithmically; rounding merges some of the narrowest, so 16 gives 15.
vocoder.mix: How far each band moves to the modulator's level: 0 changes nothing, 1 imposes it fully.

pan.block: Which blocks' attention is biased: one block, a range such as 3-7, or all.
pan.depth: How far the farthest key is pushed, in units of attention score: the bias reaches pan × depth at the start.
pan.pan: Which way attention moves: above 0 toward the most recent tokens, below 0 toward the start; 0 changes nothing.

rewrite.block: The block whose MLP is edited (GPT-2 small has blocks 0 to 11).
rewrite.prompt: A sentence that leads up to the fact, ending where the target should follow.
rewrite.subject: The words in the prompt the fact is about; the edit is keyed to their last token.
rewrite.target: What the model should write after the prompt, usually with a leading space.
rewrite.save: A name to also save the edit under in data/patches, for the Patch strip to load.
rewrite.amount: How much of the edit is added: 0 changes nothing, 1 is the fitted edit, 2 doubles it.

patch.file: The patch's name in data/patches, without .safetensors.
patch.scale: How much of the saved change is added for the run: 0 changes nothing, 1 adds it as saved.

token.word: The word or words, between commas and with their leading spaces: " not, never".
token.mode: zero gives the word a zero input embedding wherever it occurs; ban stops the model writing it.

contrast.keep: Only tokens with at least this share of the diverged model's top chance can be chosen.
contrast.alpha: How strongly the original model's chances are divided out; 0 changes nothing.

sample.mode: ban-top forbids the likeliest tokens, ceiling forbids any above a chance, invert favours the least likely.
sample.k: For ban-top, how many of the most probable next tokens are forbidden.
sample.p: For ceiling, the highest chance a token may have and still be chosen.

chorus.voices: How many detuned copies run beside the dry chain; 0 is neutral, and each voice is one more pass at every step.
chorus.sigma: The detune: each voice's noise at the layer, as a share of the stream's size there (its root mean square).
chorus.layer: The one layer whose stream the voices add their noise to, 0 (the embedding) to 12.

tap.layer: The layer whose stream is read through the final norm and the output layer: 12 is the model's own output, 0 the embedding.

meter.layer: The layer whose stream's size (its L2 norm) is shown at each token: 0 is the embedding, 12 the last block's output.

gauge.dir: The direction to measure along, made unit length at the layer read; negation ships with the Lens.
gauge.layer: The layer whose stream is measured against the direction.

scope.head: The head to watch, as block.head counted from 0: 4.11 is block 4's last head.
